title: Meet Angus Liddell, Melbourne student who raised $10,000, launched a 10km charity swim
summary_full: Recognized for his outstanding community service, Angus Liddell earned Kingston’s Young Citizen of the Year award. Through his initiative to host a charity swim event, he successfully generated substantial funds for various worthy causes. Additionally, he set a remarkable fundraising record at his college and engaged in lifesaving volunteer work, showcasing the meaningful influence that young leaders can have within their communities.
